pages.title: Unclaimed Equipment
pages.text: Weapons, armor, bows, tools and accessories can arrive unidentified. Their category, tier and rarity tell you what sort of reward to expect.$(br2)Visit an $(l:workshop/identify)Identifier counter$(/l) to reveal the equipment. Keep some XP points ready.

pages.title: No Travel Rerolls
pages.text: The drop remembers its origin dimension. Carrying an Aether drop home keeps its Aether reward pool.$(br2)The $(l:records/preview)reward preview$(/l) shows the currently eligible equipment and each item's share of the pool. Inspecting it does not consume your drop.
